dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product shows how far a task has come — or that it is under way when that is unknown — as a bar in content and as a ring in tight places, at several sizes.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a progress indicator reads: the bar's thickness and the ring's size and stroke per size, the track and indicator colors, the ends' shape, whether the indicator meets the track or stands a gap from it, that gap and the stop indicator at the track's end, and the motion of a value change and of an indeterminate cycle.
rules: Use a determinate indicator whenever the fraction is known; indeterminate only when it is not.
Always give it a label (the accessible name); use valueText when a percentage is not the natural reading ("3 of 10 files").
indicator.color on track.color must stay distinguishable (3:1): the boundary between them is the value.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never draw a bar of your own.

track.separation follows sys.behavior.separation and decides track.gap, which is drawn under gap only. stop-indicator.size is independent of the separation: a determinate bar draws the dot under either whenever it is above 0 (0 in the default system). Set either to 0 to keep it out.

thickness.$description: The bar's height: its container height, per size. The bar has no length of its own; it fills the inline size its layout gives it.

size.$description: The ring's square box (its container), per size: small fits in a control, medium next to text, large in a section.

thickness.$description: The ring's stroke width, per size. The same stroke at every size by default.

shape.$description: The corner radius of the bar's ends and of the indicator's ends, clamped to half the thickness. The ring's caps are round unless this is sys.shape.corner.none.

separation.$description: How a determinate indicator is told from the rest of its track. divider: the indicator is drawn on the track with no space between them; the edge where its color ends is the line. gap: track.gap of empty space is left between them. Whether a bar draws the stop indicator is stop-indicator.size, not this. Follows the system's choice; an instance's separation prop overrides it (PRG-17). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product cuts its progress bars with a gap as it cuts its joined buttons, or keeps its bars solid while its buttons stand apart: the system-wide choice gives the common answer, and a component whose parts read better the other way must be able to leave it.

gap.$description: Under gap: empty space, measured along the track, between the end of a determinate indicator and the rest of the track. Not drawn under divider.

size.$description: The diameter of the dot a determinate bar draws at the track's end, in the indicator color, to mark where the track ends, under either separation; never drawn larger than the bar is thick, and not drawn while the indicator covers it at max. 0 draws none.

cycle-duration.$description: One cycle of the indeterminate animation (the bar's segment crossing the track once, the ring's arc turning once), and one pulse of its reduced-motion form.

cycle-easing.$description: How the bar's indeterminate segment and the reduced-motion pulse move through a cycle. The ring always turns at constant speed.
